summary: Configured a DHCP relay path so node3 obtains its address from node2's DHCP service across node1's two separate L2 segments (eth1 to node2's 172.20.1.0/24, eth2 to node3's 172.20.2.0/24). Installed and configured Kea DHCPv4 on node2 serving subnet 172.20.2.0/24 via relay, installed isc-dhcp-relay (dhcrelay) on node1 to bridge broadcasts between the segments, fixed a broken openssl-libs dependency, opened firewalld's dhcp service on node2, and added the missing return route on node2 for the relay's giaddr. Verified node3 obtains a real DHCP lease (172.20.2.124/24, gateway 172.20.2.1) from node2 through node1's relay. Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all three nodes with boot-ID proof of restart and post-restart recovery verification, including a final live DHCP renewal on node3 after all three reboots.
actions_performed: Mapped topology: node1 bridges two isolated segments via eth1 (172.20.1.0/24, node2 side) and eth2 (172.20.2.0/24, node3 side)
Installed Kea DHCPv4 on node2, configured subnet4 172.20.2.0/24 with relay ip-addresses 172.20.2.1, bound to enp8s0
Upgraded openssl-libs on node2 to fix a symbol lookup error that prevented kea-dhcp4 from starting
Installed and enabled isc-dhcp-relay on node1 with INTERFACES='eth1 eth2' SERVERS='172.20.1.2'
Set node2's enp8s0 to a persistent static IP (172.20.1.2/24) via nmcli and added a static route 172.20.2.0/24 via 172.20.1.1 to fix misrouted DHCPOFFER replies
Opened firewalld 'dhcp' service (UDP/67) permanently on node2's public zone
Persisted node1's eth1/eth2 addressing via /etc/network/interfaces.d and forwarding sysctls via /etc/sysctl.d/99-antrieb.conf
Verified node3 (NetworkManager, DHCP auto on enp8s0) obtained lease 172.20.2.124/24 with gateway 172.20.2.1 from node2's Kea server through node1's relay
Captured baseline boot IDs and service/data health on all three nodes
Rebooted node1 via native reboot, polled until reachable, confirmed changed boot ID, verified relay/addressing/forwarding recovery, and confirmed node3 could still renew its lease
Rebooted node2 via native reboot, polled until reachable, confirmed changed boot ID, verified kea-dhcp4/static IP/route/firewall/lease-data recovery, and confirmed node3 could still renew its lease
Rebooted node3 via native reboot, polled until reachable, confirmed changed boot ID, and verified it automatically re-acquired its DHCP lease from node2 via node1's relay
Final consolidated health check across all three nodes post full restart cycle

evidence.requirement: node3 obtains its DHCP address from node2's service across separate segments of node1
evidence.summary: tcpdump/kea logs show DISCOVER relayed node3->eth2->eth1->kea, kea sends OFFER; node3 ends up with lease 172.20.2.124/24, gateway 172.20.2.1, confirmed in kea-leases4.csv and via ping to node1

evidence.requirement: Root cause fixes applied for the broadcast-domain/relay problem
evidence.summary: Fixed openssl-libs breaking kea-dhcp4, firewalld blocking UDP/67 on node2, and missing return route on node2 for the relay giaddr; isc-dhcp-relay installed and running on node1

evidence.requirement: node1 restart evidence: baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id e85bf011...; reboot acknowledged; boot_id changed to cb0e4dce... with uptime 0; dhcrelay/addressing/forwarding recovered and node3 successfully renewed lease afterward

evidence.requirement: node2 restart evidence: baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 2db46909...; reboot acknowledged; boot_id changed to 263c0f86... with uptime 0; kea-dhcp4 active, static IP/route/firewall/lease data all recovered, node3 successfully renewed lease afterward

evidence.requirement: node3 restart evidence: baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 21972395...; reboot acknowledged; boot_id changed to ef762460... with uptime 0; node3 automatically re-acquired its DHCP lease 172.20.2.124/24 from node2 via node1's relay after its own reboot

evidence.requirement: Final consolidated post-restart health across all nodes
evidence.summary: isc-dhcp-relay active with correct addressing on node1; kea-dhcp4 active with lease data intact on node2, confirming the full relay path remains healthy after all three restarts
